You are already in your seat. The aircraft has just been pushed back from the gate and the engines are running. Buckle up, look out of the window, talk to the person next to you, get a coffee from the trolley, and ride the whole flight in real time. Nothing is scripted: two pilots fly the aircraft through its controls, ATC picks the runways from the wind you set, and everything that happens comes out of the flight physics and the weather.

Fan-made simulation, not affiliated with SAS, Airbus, CFM, Swedavia or Copenhagen Airports. Coastlines and lakes from Natural Earth; runway coordinates from OurAirports. SK1415's 06:00 departure matches the published schedule; other departure times use representative flight numbers.

Set the conditions at Arlanda and Kastrup; between them they blend along the route. The pilots read the METARs below, ATC picks the runways from the wind, and the atmosphere turns it all into physics: wind shear near the ground, gusts and turbulence, storm updrafts, downdrafts, lightning and microbursts.
